notes: The Season 9 sources expose The Hood as a Team-Up partner before full independent live-roster details were consistently published.

The Hood is included as an inactive Vanguard to keep partner validation strict; his directional partners are manually inferred from visible Season 9 pairings and should be rechecked when the official hero page is live.
Inactive heroes are valid Team-Up partners but are excluded from generated six-hero teams.
Deadpool uses Duelist as his primary role and Strategist as an eligible flex role for 2-2-2 assignment.
This project does not hardcode generated team results; counts are derived from heroes.json and teamups.json.
